Name: Sekun's Vegetable Garden
Author: RiftstalkerSekun
Description:
Have you ever wanted just a few new crops for each season? A little something new, a little something unusual? 
Vegetable Garden aims to add just a dash of life's favorite spice, variety, to your farm fields! With only two crops per season, things won't get overwhelming, and they're balanced against vanilla crops so they won't be overpowered. And it's just the crops, no new recipes or anything else to worry about, so you can focus on the farming! All seeds are available starting year one (except for Hubbard Squash, which is available Spring Year 2), and all seeds are purchased from Pierre's shop.

With that out of the way, let's get into the crops themselves!

SPRING--
Hubbard Squash and Endive. Hubbard Squash is available starting in Year 2.

SUMMER--
Scallop Squash and Garden Pea. Garden Peas are a regrowth crop, giving multiple harvests per season.

FALL--
Pinto Bean and Sweet Potato. Pinto Beans are a regrowth crop, giving multiple harvests per season. They are also intended to be processed in a Dehydrator, requiring 5 Pinto Beans to dry into a Sack of Dried Pinto Beans. If playing with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29299]Selph's Fresh Farm Produce mod,[/url] sacks of Dried Pinto Beans count towards the Ingredient category in contests!

WINTER--
Wax Bean and Broccolini. Wax Beans are a regrowth crop, giving multiple harvests per season.

If you made it down this far, thanks for reading! Have an awesome day!
